description.text: The specialty can be conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 6 students for Master's degree. Training Objectives The course is designed to train nursing professionals with basic knowledge in humanity and social science, medicine and preventative care as well as the basic theories and skills of nursing, who can be engaged in clinical nursing, preventative care and nursing supervision in the nursing field. Training Requirements Studengts are required to study and grasp the basic theories and laws and regulations relevant to humanity and social science, preclinical medicine, and preventative health; to understand the basic theory, knowledge and skill of nursing, nursing principle and operating technology of acute and chronic patients, and special nursing and care skills; to apply nursing procedures to conduct overall nursing; and to have such basic abilities as in community health services, nursing management and nursing education with some nursing research capacity. Curriculum human anatomy, physiology, pathogenic organism, pathophysiology, pathology, pharmacology, nursing ethics, nursing psychology, health assessment, medical nursing, surgical nursing, nursing for gynecology, obstetrics, and pediatrics, psychiatric nursing, nursing for emergency treatment, community nursing, nursing management and so on. Employment orientation It is suitable for graduates to be engaged in clinicai nursing, nursing management as well as teaching and research work in hospitals at all levels, medical collages and universities as well as medical research institutions.

duration.text: The Nursing at Central South University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7.Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. Applicant should hold Bachelor's Degree or equivalent to a Chinese Bachelor's Degree 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 35
